The Title Sierra

Condominium in Bang Tao
HomeSaleThe Title Sierra

Project overview

Three eight-storey residential buildings in Bang Tao, 452 units on about 6,950 sqm, with mountain views and a nature-balanced design.

Bang Tao Beach and beach clubs are 2.4 to 4 km away. Prices and availability on request via WhatsApp.

The Title Sierra: key facts

  • The Title Sierra is a condominium in Bang Tao, Phuket, developed by Rhom Bho Property PLC (The Title).
  • Units: 1–2 bedrooms, 28.4–62.9 sqm.
  • Construction status: pre-sale; completion listed as Jul 2028.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Freehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿2,906,700.
  • Nearest beach: Bang Tao Beach (2.4-4 km).
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Bang Tao Beach (2.4-4 km); Retail and wellness (50-800 m); Thalang Hospital (5.0 km, straight line); Wattanapat Hospital Phuket (5.1 km, straight line).
  • More projects by Rhom Bho Property in our catalogue: Darayana Kamala, The Title Cocoon, The Title Adora Rawai, Biancana, Casa De Monte, Coralina Kamala.
